skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of cadastral surveying, including mathematical foundations, principles, and methods for collecting land data and creating cadastral maps.
Learn to design, measure, and compile cadastral maps and land records.
Manage and utilize cadastral maps and records for land management tasks.
Apply geomatics principles to analyze and interpret cadastral data.
Apply cadastral data and maps to land management tasks.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve problems in land management.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Demonstrate the ability to independently study and complete assignments.
Write technical reports and presentations based on cadastral data.
Analyze and interpret data from cadastral surveys.
